not-yet.response: 18 is larger than 12 so non-users do better; the campaign proves causation.
not-yet.why: Unequal denominators are ignored and causation is invented.

assisted.response: With a denominator prompt I calculate 20% and 15%, and say the difference is five percentage points.
assisted.why: Correct calculation after a solving prompt is assisted.

independent.response: 12/60 is 20%; 18/120 is 15%. The absolute difference is 5 percentage points; relative increase is 5/15, about 33.3%, not twice. Selection and follow-up are unknown; this does not establish that the campaign caused the difference.
independent.why: Arithmetic, denominators, relative/absolute distinction, missing methods and causal limits are all shown.

advanced.response: If follow-up differs between groups, I check comparable measurement before using even the descriptive comparison. I seek the original methods rather than treating the headline as evidence.
advanced.why: Handles a changed measurement constraint and lowers the certainty of the conclusion appropriately.
